_comment: Every rule number lives here with its rule label (PLAN 5.3). Playtest changes are edits to this file. 'Q..' = Vidi ruling or suggested default in PLAN.md section 11.
name: Playtest 2 rules + Vidi's 2026-10-21 update (rules.md Oct 21 2026)

provinceFloor.rule: Vidi 2026-10-17, Q64 (global floor of 1, allied provinces included)

revoltMayReachZero.rule: Vidi 2026-10-17, explicit exception to the global floor (Q69)

startProvinceMinDistance.rule: 20.o, 4.b (Vidi 2026-10-21: at least 2 provinces between starts = shortest path >= 3); Q55

rewardMode.rule: Q5 default (16.k split, setup checkbox to re-randomise)

maxPlayers.rule: Q4/Q55/Q74: 4 generals exist (15.i) but no 4-province start set satisfies 20.o, so 4 players wait for Vidi (Q74)

unusedActionGold.rule: 17.o (Vidi 2026-10-21: +1 Gold per unused action, replaces the +2 pass bonus)

startProvinceGold.rule: 17.d, 20.k, 17.t (Vidi 2026-10-21: +1 Gold per turn while the start province is held and never defeated in battle)

romaMaxTroops.rule: 12.k, 12.g, 12.l (Vidi 2026-10-21: Roma never above 20; extra troops are lost)

revoltImmuneAtTroops.rule: 17.c, 18.m, 19.d (Vidi 2026-10-21: 10+ troops never revolts, still counts toward the threshold)

carthageBackTroops.rule: 16.n, 12.g (Carthage comes back with 5 when Roma falls and the game goes on)

attackOriginKeeps.rule: 17.g, 17.i, 20.k (Vidi 2026-10-21: the origin keeps only the floor of 1; held Roma keeps 10, 12.l)

gameCardTroopSource.rule: 17.s (Vidi 2026-10-21: any province that keeps 1; held Roma keeps 10)

uniqueHeldCards.rule: 18.t, 18.w, 18.y, 18.l (max 1 held each; a 2nd draw is shuffled back and redrawn; Horn added 2026-10-22)

generalMove.rule: 15.j, 17.e, 17.z (Vidi 2026-10-22: free, not an action, after the Revolt Roll; oncePerTurn and chainOnly are Boardicca's defaults; chainOnly=false allows any own province)

sellCard.rule: 20.p, 17.o (Vidi 2026-10-22: on your own turn, 2 Gold from the bank, not an action; fromSaved = saved Resource cards count as cards in hand, Q103 default)

assassinTargets.rule: 18.e, 18.i, 12.g, 12.l, 16.n (Vidi 2026-10-22: provinces you don't control, never Roma, never neutral Carthage; unknown natives are not targets and struck natives heal as in 17.v, Q102 defaults)

discardPiles.rule: 18.l (Vidi 2026-10-21: used cards go to their deck's discard pile; it is shuffled into a new draw pile when the draw pile is empty)

caesarFleeMinEnemy.rule: 15.b (Vidi 2026-10-21: the flee does nothing against a lone troop)

borrowJudgedAt.rule: 19.c, 17.q, Q73 (Vidi 2026-10-21: borrowing judged at declaration; alternative 'afterLeaving')

startIncomeLostOn.rule: 20.k, Q79 (Vidi 2026-10-21: a held defence keeps it)

attackThroughNeutralWalls.rule: 16.n, 19.k, Q80 (Vidi 2026-10-21: Walls count against the real origin's side; alternative 'entrySide')

hornOnlyUnderGarrisoned.rule: 18.y, Q85 default (the 'protects an under-garrisoned province' headline is read as flavour)

defendingGeneralOnCapture.rule: 17.c by analogy, Q86 default (a general in a captured province escapes to the owner's nearest other province)

survivorsMayReturn.rule: 17.y, Q59 default (own survivors may be split back to the origin; 1 stays, Roma 0)

earlyRetreatCardsBack.rule: 17.k, 18.i (Vidi 2026-10-25, Q141-Q144): the attacker retreats after 3 or fewer rolled rounds (or before round 1): the defender takes back its battle cards not used yet

returnCommittedElephantsOnEarlyRetreat.rule: 17.k, 18.i (Vidi Q141, 2026-10-25): committed Elephants count as not used for the early-retreat return

scipioPerkScope.rule: 15.c, Q18 default (chosen once, +1 or the extra die in every round)

laterRoundCardWindows.rule: 18.i, Q17 default (no new battle cards after round 1; committed Moral boosts queue)

caesarFledFromAttacker.rule: 15.b, Q88 (Vidi 2026-10-21): when Caesar defends, a borrowed attacker troop flees first, an own one only if no borrowed is left; 'ownFirst' = the old default

bribeOwnerPrestigeLoss.rule: 18.v, Q89 (open, default): Prestige the old owner loses when Bribe the Ally! takes the province; 1 = treat it as a lost territory (12.f)

beeGoldTo.rule: 18.x, Q90 (open, default): 'taxRoute' = the holder of Roma while someone else holds it, else Roma's Gold pile; 'romaPile' = always Roma's Gold pile

recallRedirectedThrough.rule: 18.o, Q91 (open, default): a recalled victim has no general perks through 'nextOwnTurn' (their next own turn) or 'currentTurn' (only the turn it was drawn)

removedAllowsAllied.rule: 18.q, Q92 (open, default): Emperor removes you from a Province! may restore an allied province too (false = conquered only)
